At a glance

Make network behaviour visible enough to reason about.

SimulationNetworksVisualizationPython
Goal

Queueing, route choice, and congestion are easier to understand when the network can be watched while it runs. The project makes those interactions visible and connects them to statistics rather than producing a single fixed animation.

Build

The repository combines simulation logic, a visual interface, a recorded demonstration, and a statistics report. Parameters can be changed so route and load effects remain inspectable rather than being fixed in one animation.

Takeaway

A simulator is most useful when it connects a visible event to a measurable quantity. The project strengthened Medha’s interest in tools that let people explore system behaviour instead of only seeing a final number.
